property_summary: After initialization, for any non-zero implementation address the owner's call to updateRoundImplementation succeeds and leaves roundImplementation() equal to that address; the mutant's inverted require reverts for every non-zero address, so a successful call never sets the getter.
change_summary: Invert the zero-address require from != to == so the call reverts for any non-zero implementation and only succeeds for the zero address.
